notes: RAWG slug is guardians-of-the-galaxy. No StrategyWiki page. On marvel.fandom.com the plain title is a disambiguation page; the game page is "Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy (video game)", with about 284 linked pages; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema calls the app "Project9" (an internal codename); the store list confirms app 1088850. 25 of 59 Steam achievements are hidden; most are named after story chapters and sit in the main story chapter. Paying the Nova Corps fine and winning the bet against Rocket are early story choices, so they sit there too.
